verdict.rationale: Tavily is a hosted web-search API, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions data residency, regional storage, or region selection. Nearby items do not qualify: the JavaScript SDK proxy parameter is a client network setting, the language parameter only ranks search results, and the PII-blocking claim is a different privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
